seg_bridge.title: Sleep Care and the shared layer turn Sleep Media's profit into a loss.
seg_bridge.sub: EBITDA by segment, $M, 2026 forecast. Sleep Media is shown before shared cost, at the lower of the plan's two figures.

standalone.title: Trailing stand-alone earnings sit below both last year and this year's forecast.
standalone.sub: Sleep Media stand-alone EBITDA at $2.6M of corporate cost, $M.

care_loss.title: Sleep Care's monthly loss has grown in most months of the year.
care_loss.sub: Sleep Care EBITDA loss, $K a month, 2026. Actual to August, plan from September.

clock_gantt.title: Cash interest starts in December, and the earnings test follows in March.
clock_gantt.sub: Default calendar from 16 November 2026 to 31 March 2027. The claret line is 16 November.

rows.label: Cash interest
rows.note: From 1 December, about $0.9M a month on $103.1M

debt_stack.title: Comvest and Falcon hold the two largest balances in the debt.
debt_stack.sub: Debt by holder, $M, September 2026. Senior shares are the April 2024 allocation.

clicks.title: Weekly clicks have fallen for six weeks and remain above the trigger.
clicks.sub: Google clicks on sleepfoundation.org by week beginning Monday, thousands. The sale-review trigger is 176K a week.

bestof.title: Clicks on the best-of pages have been flat for four weeks.
bestof.sub: Google clicks on pages with /best- in the address, thousands a week.

cases_search.title: The Severe case earns less than half the High case's search revenue.

rank_heat.title: The broad mattress terms have gained rank, and the specialist terms have lost it.
rank_heat.sub: Average position on Google for sleepfoundation.org by query, autumn 2026 against a year earlier. A lower number is a higher rank. The year-earlier positions for the first two terms are approximate.

positioning.title: Sleep Media's revenue fell further than the larger publishers' did.
positioning.sub: Change in Google traffic against change in revenue, 2026 on 2025, %. Periods and revenue lines differ by publisher and are named in the source line.

jan_aug.title: Revenue and contribution both fell in the first eight months.
jan_aug.sub: Sleep Media, $M, January to August, 2026 against 2025.

rev_sources.title: One site earns most of Sleep Media's revenue.
rev_sources.sub: Sleep Media revenue by source, $M, 2026 forecast of $16.3M.

yield.title: Revenue per click has risen through the year, helped by the click floor.
yield.sub: Revenue per click out to merchants, $. Actual to August 2026. September to December is the plan, and the last row is the weighted average for 2026, about.

covenant.title: The earnings test rises each quarter through next year.
covenant.sub: Minimum twelve-month EBITDA under today's terms, $M. The plan's two covenant sheets show −$3.0M and −$11.2M at March 2027.

claim.title: The senior claim would keep growing under management's request.
claim.sub: Senior claim, $M, with interest paid in kind. December 2027 and December 2029 are on the request of 19 October, about.

pub_traffic.title: Listed publishers lost Google traffic of the same order.
pub_traffic.sub: Fall in Google traffic, %, Q3 2026 on a year earlier. Ziff Davis is organic referrals, about; People Inc. is Google search traffic.

people.title: Sleep Media's own team is the smallest of the three groups.

ai_ref.title: AI referral revenue rose about fivefold over the summer.

oct_clicks.title: October clicks were about half of last year's.
oct_clicks.sub: Google clicks on sleepfoundation.org, thousands, October.

liquidity.title: Average monthly liquidity has fallen by about two thirds.

sale_hold.title: A March sale is worth more to Comvest than a hold on each case.
sale_hold.sub: Comvest's value, $M, present value at 16 November 2026. Sales at 3.5 times forward EBITDA, and 2.5 times in the Severe case.

indiff_ev.title: The bid that beats a hold depends on the case.
indiff_ev.sub: Enterprise value in March 2027 at which a sale equals a hold, $M, if a later buyer pays 3.5 times. On the Severe case any serious bid beats the hold.

series.name: Enterprise value that beats the hold

indiff_mult.title: The point of indifference falls if a later buyer would pay less.
indiff_mult.sub: March 2027 multiple of forward EBITDA at which a sale equals a hold, by case.

gate_gantt.title: The evidence for the gate arrives between December and mid-January.
gate_gantt.sub: When each piece of evidence falls due, 16 November 2026 to 15 January 2027.

rows.label: Click read
rows.note: First read about 1 December; confirmed through December

rows.label: Buyer indications
rows.note: Tracks open 1 December; written indications mid-January

tool_cost.title: A handover costs a fraction of a court sale.
tool_cost.sub: Estimated cost of each tool, $M, low to high.

tool_time.title: A board change is the fastest tool, and a court sale the slowest.
tool_time.sub: Longest estimated time for each tool, weeks. Six months is shown as 26 weeks. The board change runs from a default, and the handover from a term sheet.

shares.title: Comvest holds the majority of the senior loan.
shares.sub: Share of the senior term loan, %, April 2024 allocation, the latest seen.

strip.title: A take-out pays where the strip's share exceeds the price.
strip.sub: Vistria Credit's 26.8% of lender cash at a March close against a $7M take-out, $M.

series.name: Vistria Credit's share of lender cash

lincoln.title: Lender takeovers have multiplied in US private credit.
lincoln.sub: Lender takeovers counted by Lincoln International, $B. The 2025 figure is over $24B.

route_time.title: The equity route is quicker, and the asset route leaves more behind.
route_time.sub: Estimated weeks to complete each handover structure.

cac.title: Acquisition cost has fallen by more than half since September.
cac.sub: Sleep Care acquisition cost per new patient, $. The budget is $155 blended.

patients.title: Weekly new patients have risen by about half since late September.
patients.sub: New patients a week, 2026. The count mixes cash orders, scheduled consultations, and insurance forms at an assumed 28% conversion.

cohorts.title: No cohort has yet repaid its acquisition cost.
cohorts.sub: First-order profit per dollar of acquisition cost by cohort, as observed on 15 November 2026. A ratio of 1.00 repays the cost, and the budget was 1.48. Cohorts are at different ages.

series.name: Profit per dollar of acquisition cost

care_pl.title: Marketing and payroll together cost more than Sleep Care's gross profit.
care_pl.sub: Sleep Care, $M, 2026 on the long-range plan.

severance.title: The bridge carries a fraction of the earlier severance estimate.
severance.sub: Severance, $M. The earlier estimate is for all leavers, about.

sep_cost.title: Each step of separation costs more than the one before.
sep_cost.sub: Estimated one-off cost of each step, $M, low to high. Technical separation also costs $0.3M to $0.6M a year.

registry.title: Three registrations fall due by mid-January.
registry.sub: Time from 10 November 2026 to each registry expiry, as read on that date. The claret line is 16 November. sleepdoctor.com runs to 19 January 2028 and is not shown.

rows.label: sleepfoundation.org
rows.note: Registry expiry 11 November 2026: confirm the renewal has gone through

budget.title: Cash payroll is about half of MediaCo's budget.
budget.sub: MediaCo cash budget for 2027 by block, $M. Total $5.20M.

team.title: Search and content is the largest group in MediaCo's team.
team.sub: Roles in the working roster of about 15 people. One or two roles can be part-time.

levers.title: No growth lever is counted until it is contracted.
levers.sub: Earlier risk-weighted value of each lever, $M. None is in the funding base or the value cases.

process.title: A strategic process is worth far more than a distressed one.
process.sub: Enterprise value of Sleep Media on the Central case by kind of process, $M, on forward EBITDA at March 2027.

referral.title: A referral agreement could add contracted revenue to MediaCo.
referral.sub: Illustrative annual referral fees to MediaCo, $M: 1,000 to 2,000 qualified referrals a month at $40 to $60. The figure is in no value in this document.

val_case.title: Comvest recovers most on the High case and little on the Severe case.
val_case.sub: Comvest's value for a March 2027 sale of Sleep Media, $M, by case.

val_date.title: Value to Comvest falls with each later closing date.
val_date.sub: Comvest's value by closing date and case, $M. Later sales include the cash swept before closing.

mult_heat.title: Value rises with the multiple on every case.
mult_heat.sub: Comvest's value for a March 2027 sale, $M, by case and sale multiple of forward EBITDA.

weighted.title: On judgement weights a sale is worth close to the September mark.
weighted.sub: Comvest's value for Sleep Media on judgement weights of 20%, 35%, 30% and 15%, $M, against the value implied by the September 2026 mark.

sens.title: The multiple and search revenue move Comvest's value most.
sens.sub: Size of the change in Comvest's value on the Central case, $M. Timing, cost and tax reduce value, and the others can move it either way. The Sleep Care row is the top of a range that starts at nil.

bridge.title: Uncontracted levers explain most of the gap to a full harvest.
bridge.sub: Comvest's value, $M, from a full five-year harvest with every lever to the cases in this plan.

marks.title: The latest mark implies the lowest value of the three.
marks.sub: Value of Comvest's position implied by each holder's mark, $M, on 58.9% of the $103.1M December balance.

cash_line.title: Month-end cash stays above the reserve on the bridge as built.
cash_line.sub: Month-end cash, $M, Central case, December 2026 to September 2027, against the $2.0M reserve. Cash above $3.0M is swept.

stress.title: Every stress tested takes cash below the reserve.
stress.sub: Lowest month-end cash, $M, against a $2.0M reserve. The first row is the bridge as built. The last row is about $0.5M, in June.

trans.title: Transition cost is heaviest in December and gone by April.
trans.sub: Transition cost by month and kind, $M, December 2026 to March 2027. $3.65M in all.

sweep.title: The sweep to the lenders begins in May.
sweep.sub: Cash swept to the lenders by month, $M, 2027, Central case. $2.29M to September.

receipts.title: Receipts are highest in December and January.
receipts.sub: Sleep Media receipts by month, $M, Central case, December 2026 to September 2027.

season.title: The last four months carry the largest share of the year's revenue.
season.sub: Share of annual revenue by month, %, from the 2026 plan. Actual to August.

rev_cases.title: Revenue falls each year on every case.

ebitda_cases.title: Earnings fall each year as search revenue declines.
ebitda_cases.sub: Sleep Media EBITDA by case, $M. The Severe case turns negative in 2029 and is in the table.

roadmap.title: The plan runs about nineteen weeks to a March close.
roadmap.sub: Main steps from 16 November 2026 to 31 March 2027. The claret line is 16 November.

rows.label: Core update
rows.note: Began 10 November; due to complete about 24 November

rows.label: Forbearance
rows.note: Signed before 30 November; runs to 29 January

rows.label: Signing, closing
rows.note: February to March; target close 31 March

first2w.title: The first gates all fall within two weeks.

risks.title: The search risk is larger than every other risk to Comvest's value.
risks.sub: Size of the effect on Comvest's value, $M, for the risks the plan sizes, about. The Sleep Care row is the top of a $1.2M to $1.8M range.

options.title: On the harvest method most options sit within a narrow range.
options.sub: Pool value of each option on a five-year harvest with every lever, $M. This is a different method from the plan's and is shown for reference.

findings_status.title: More findings hold than need watching.

decisions_due.title: Most of the decisions are needed before December.
decisions_due.sub: Decisions asked of Comvest by when each is needed.

steps_month.title: More than half the steps fall before the end of December.
steps_month.sub: Steps in the roadmap by month.

coverage.title: Earnings, capital and the plan are best covered, and operations least.
coverage.sub: Aspects of the assessment template by function: partly supported and lacking evidence.

checks.title: Most checked statements were right in part.
checks.sub: Twenty-two statements tested against the source records, by result.

bridge_a5.title: On the Central case a March sale leaves Comvest about $14.9M.
bridge_a5.sub: From enterprise value to Comvest's value, $M, Central case, sale closing March 2027. Enterprise value is 3.5 times forward EBITDA of $7.43M. The discount and the other lenders' share are the differences between the table's columns.

case_rev.title: Search revenue is the line that separates the cases.
case_rev.sub: Sleep Media revenue in 2027 by source and case, $M.

rebuild.title: The model and the independent rebuild give nearly the same values.
rebuild.sub: Pool, present value, $M, on the Low case's inputs.

items_due.title: Most open items fall due by mid-December.
items_due.sub: The 32 open diligence items by when each is needed.

items_owner.title: The company and restructuring counsel own most of the open items.
items_owner.sub: The 32 open diligence items by first-named owner.

op_fte.title: The human work left after AI needs several people, whoever employs them.
op_fte.sub: Full-time equivalents of human work that remain after AI, by kind of work, low and high estimate. The total is about 6 to 9.

op_models.title: No model that keeps the testing and review costs less than about $4.0M.
op_models.sub: Cost a year by staffing model, $M, in 2027 dollars. The run-off and the strict model end the testing and the review.

op_bridge.title: About half of the payroll saving is spent again on outside firms and tools.
op_bridge.sub: From the day-one budget to the six-person budget, $M a year in 2027 dollars.

rows.label: 0 Hold and build
rows.note: Now to the handover, expected February to March 2027. No change to Sleep Media's team

rows.label: The gate
rows.note: Hold or sell, on or about 15 January 2027

rows.label: 1 Prove
rows.note: The first 90 days of MediaCo: a pilot on about 50 pages against a matched control

rows.label: 2 Extend
rows.note: Months 4 to 9: roll-out; finance, security and video move outside

rows.label: 3 Settle
rows.note: Months 9 to 12: the team reduces to the core of six

op_stages.title: No role goes before its workflow is proved on a small set of pages.
op_stages.sub: Four stages from 16 November 2026 to early 2028, on a handover in March 2027. The claret line is 16 November.

op_ladder.title: The team and its cost step down as revenue falls.
op_ladder.sub: Cost a year by rung of Sleep Media revenue, $M, at the middle of each range.

op_runoff.title: A sale at 2.5 times beats a run-off on most rates of decline.
op_runoff.sub: Severe case: value to the lender pool by route, $M, present value at 16 November 2026. The sale is at 2.5 times, and the run-off rows differ in how fast revenue falls after 2027.

series.name: Hold with six people, buyer pays for the saving

op_value.title: A March sale still leads a hold on each case, even with the smaller team.
op_value.sub: Comvest's value for Sleep Media by case, $M, present value at 16 November 2026. A hold closes in June 2028 at 3.5 times.

op_week.title: A single operator's week runs to 62 hours before leave or illness.
op_week.sub: Hours a week for the one employee, with content approval already handed to an outside editor. Total 62.

op_breakeven.title: A small fall in revenue cancels the saving from each model that keeps the work.
op_breakeven.sub: Further fall in 2027 revenue that cancels each model's saving, %, on High-case and Low-case revenue.

op_worth.title: The 3Z floor is worth about three times the saving from the smaller team.
op_worth.sub: Worth a month, $K, about: the 3Z floor to 31 December 2026, a tenth of 2027 search revenue on the Central case, the saving from the core of six, and the further saving from going to one employee.

op_staffing.title: A company with a single employee still relies on several outside people.
op_staffing.sub: Employees and outside full-time equivalents by staffing model. Outside figures are the middle of each range.

op_revcases.title: On the Central and Low cases revenue reaches the next rung within a few years.
op_revcases.sub: Sleep Media revenue by case, $M, 2027 to 2031. The rungs of the staffing ladder sit at $14M, $11M and $8M.
